meta.title: Casa Brisa · Vacation home at Praia da Daniela, Florianópolis
meta.description: 3-bedroom house 150 m from Praia da Daniela beach in Florianópolis, Brazil. Pet friendly, barbecue, garden and free EV charging. Book directly with the owners.

hero.titulo: Your retreat 150 steps from the sea
hero.subtitulo: A light, welcoming house with a garden, shady trees and the calm waters of Daniela just around the corner.

texto: Casa Brisa was designed for simple days: beach in the morning, unhurried lunches and a barbecue under the trees in the late afternoon.
Three bedrooms (one en-suite), two bathrooms, an open living room and a fully equipped kitchen.

itens.texto: Double bed with a private bathroom and air conditioning.
A second double bed, with air conditioning.
Two single beds and a window onto the backyard.
Sofa, TV and a high wooden ceiling, open to the kitchen.
Island, oven, cooktop and a table for six.
Two full bathrooms: the guest one and the en-suite.
Hammock, chairs and shade right at the entrance.
Trees, grass and a pergola out back, with room for pets.

eletrico.texto: The house has a dedicated outlet to charge your electric car, at no extra cost. Only the outlet is provided, so please bring your own portable charger.

regiao.intro: Daniela is one of the calmest beaches in Florianópolis, with shallow, gentle water — ideal for families.

itens.texto: Calm, shallow water, great for kids and stand-up paddling.
One of the most beautiful sunsets on the island.
Restaurants and beach clubs a few minutes' drive away.

mapa.aviso: The exact address is shared once your booking is confirmed.

itens: A family home: parties and events are not allowed

itens.r: You pay a 30% deposit to secure your dates and the balance up to 7 days before check-in.
Yes! The house is pet friendly and has a backyard garden.

itens.p: Are bed linen and towels provided?
itens.r: Yes, bed linen and towels are included.

itens.p: Do I pay to use the EV charger?
itens.r: No, the EV charging outlet is free for guests.
